test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 09 Aug, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the underlined segment in the following sentence.**

The basketball player was a formidable opponent because he was __able to use both his left and right hands equally well.__
solution:
The correct answer is: **ambidextrous**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Ambidextrous **means being able to use both hands equally well for tasks requiring fine motor skills, such as writing or drawing. (उभयहस्त)
